doorNotes.money: Stripe is not set up yet. The door is held, but the way to take payment behind it is not built. A lawyer looks at it before it opens.
doorNotes.legal: No deal is signed yet. The door is held, and waits for the first real deal.
doorNotes.taste: In use. A person approves each post until the AI has earned more freedom, and picks which builds ship.
doorNotes.client-trust: In use. A person takes every real conversation. The AI drafts, and Simon speaks.

stages.machinery: the approved posting line, the outbox, a scrubber, and the AI's own drafts
stages.does: It finds the day's story in our own builds and drafts the post. It scrubs out anything that reads like a machine wrote it. It posts through Meta's own service, measures, and learns what works.
stages.waiting: Meta refuses the posts until our page key has two more permissions. The seat is built and tested. It goes public when that is fixed.

stages.does: It will catch the interest that marketing brings in, and draft replies. It will keep track of each lead, and pass the serious ones to a person to close.
stages.waiting: The AI already drafts proposals. The page that catches leads is the next real build.

stages.machinery: our own AI worker: it reads all our builds, puts new ones together, checks them and files them
stages.does: It runs every night. It reads our builds and adds new ones to the catalogue, with the sums for what each one saves. This seat truly runs today.

stages.machinery: the signed-door runner, the invoice sums, and the activity record
stages.does: It sends the file when someone buys. It gets the invoice ready for a person to sign. It keeps the record.
stages.waiting: A first real sale to deliver. The parts are proved. The customer is next.

stages.machinery: the nightly round: study, sweep, dream, practise the course, sit a short exam, write the morning note
stages.does: It makes every seat better over time. It tries many things, tests them, and keeps what works. It runs every night, in-house, on Simon's own electricity.

stages.machinery: fallcorp, Northgate (the running demo) and the proposal
stages.does: The company is its own case study. We say: “we run ourselves about nine parts machine to one part person. We will do it for your firm too.” It is live and public. The first sale is the next door.
